high_level_description: The image is a meme that humorously critiques modern beauty standards by comparing them to the physical features of a praying mantis. The meme is presented on an Instagram post by a user named "wamiqagabbi," as indicated by the username at the top left corner of the image. Image Content: The main focus is a drawing of a green praying mantis. The mantis is labeled with various attributes typically associated with modern beauty standards: "Small face" "Big eyes" "Sharp chin" "Thin waist" "
